notes.title: Tomorrow’s Land – UI & Graphics Update + New Auto Mode
notes.content:
🚀 Tomorrow’s Land – New Update Released![p align="start"]🔹 UI Update

Improved user interface, now more intuitive and easier to use.
[p align="start"]🔹 Graphics Update

Enhanced graphics with smoother and sharper visual effects.
[p align="start"]🔹 New Feature: Auto Mode

Added Auto Mode (press J) to support a more comfortable gameplay experience.
[p align="start"]Thank you all for supporting Tomorrow’s Land! ❤️
Please keep sharing your feedback so we can make the game even better in future updates.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258297/95299e7e03a56ebb598d9cd6abf4a3ac1b46f859.png"]

notes.title: ✨ New Update Available! ✨
notes.content:
[p align="start"]✨ New Update Available! ✨
[p align="start"]🎨 UI Update

Refreshed and improved User Interface for a smoother and modern look.
[p align="start"]🐞 Bug Fixes

Fixed a critical crash issue that caused the game to unexpectedly close.

Other minor stability improvements.
[p align="start"]🛠️ New Commands
You can now teleport quickly between islands using the chat command:



/fly @adminisland1

/fly @adminisland2

/fly @adminisland3
